answers.answer_text: For plus size hiking pants in Hong Kong, my top pick is the Columbia Silver Ridge Plus, which offers extended sizes up to 4XL in a 4-way stretch fabric. Another good option is the Quechua MH500 Plus. I would avoid the Mammut Runbold because it stops at size XL.

When shopping for plus size hiking pants, check the fit and look for extended sizes up to 4XL in a 4-way stretch fabric. Brands such as Columbia and Mammut make items in this category, but stock in Hong Kong varies, so try them on in store before buying.
